attributes.external_dependencies: ["SiteMinder XPSExport XML (XPSDeployment / XPSPolicyData shapes, archived 12.51 reference)", "SiteMinder Web Agent files WebAgent.conf / SmHost.conf / LocalConfig.conf (archived 12.52 guide, 12.8 KBs)", "SiteMinder Access Gateway server.conf and proxyrules.xml (archived SPS 12.52 guide, KB 216168 / 276675)"]
attributes.purpose: Broadcom SiteMinder product adapter, as a migration SOURCE: importer siteminder/xps reads XPSExport XML (every XPS name as data in xps.py, unverified for 12.8/12.9) into its own arc .3.6 (policy domains, realms, rules, policies, auth schemes, user directories linked to consumers, agents), partnerships/OIDC clients as standard integrations served by its identity service, header responses as edge header contracts, the rest as core source objects; importer siteminder/agent-files reads each server's Web Agent files and an Access Gateway's server.conf/proxyrules.xml (names as data in conf.py/proxyrules.py, unverified) into smWebAgent/smRoute under ou=siteminder naming their server (smServer); one projection onto the neutral protected-application layer run by both (realms, rules, policies, ignored resources, gateway backends, uncovered routes, rewrite source objects); sensitive settings withheld (smWithheld); source checks. Renders nothing.

attributes.description: A web access manager's enforcement points read from their own files into the record, one folder per server (importer siteminder/agent-files): each SiteMinder Web Agent instance (WebAgent.conf, SmHost.conf, LocalConfig.conf) as smWebAgent below its ciamServer, linked to the agent identities it acts as, its ACO/HCO/trusted-host source objects and its environment's policy servers (secrets withheld whole); an Access Gateway's server.conf virtual hosts and its proxyrules.xml flattened into ordered smRoute entries (one external DOCTYPE stripped, entities refused). SiteMinder's one projection onto the neutral protected-application layer, run by every SiteMinder importer, adds the agents' ignored extensions/URLs as unprotected resources, gateway backends and published roles, uncovered routes as unprotected applications, and blocking rewrite source objects; the routing source object is dropped once routes are read.

attributes.name: sensitive
attributes.purpose: Whether a property or agent-file setting is withheld: a sensitive name (SENSITIVE) other than NOT_SENSITIVE (sharedsecrettime), an encrypted-looking value (ENCRYPTED: {RC2}, {AES}, ...) or a value the store's secret patterns match

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.purpose: What a withheld setting is, in words: PURPOSES by name or name ending (case aside: the agent files write sharedsecret), else generic

attributes.name: carried_entry
attributes.purpose: The ciamSourceObject of kind k (CARRY: handling, role, blocking, how) for object o (None: the key store), its facts, concerns (realms, or the servers whose agent files name an ACO/HCO/trusted host) and import time; an ACO's keeps its settings as smConfig; a recorded one keeps the record's handling

attributes.name: read_export
attributes.purpose: Importer siteminder/xps: Imported from XPSExport XML files (DOCTYPE refused, other releases refused): policy domains, realms, rules, policies, schemes, user directories, agents, integrations, header contracts and source objects; plus the projection of realms, rules and policies onto the neutral protected-application layer (neutral.projection over the record after the import).

attributes.name: projection
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true, "description": "the record as the import leaves it"}, {"name": "at", "type": "datetime | None", "required": false, "description": "when the import read its files (the rewrites' ciamImportedAt)"}]
attributes.purpose: SiteMinder's one projection over the whole record, run by every SiteMinder importer: realms as applications (enforced by their agent's role, sign-on from the scheme type, timeouts, header contracts, plus a gateway application's backend and published roles from its routes), enabled rules as resources and the agent's ignored extensions/URLs as unprotected resources, enabled policies as access rules, routes no realm covers as unprotected applications, rewrite source objects; notices for event actions, agents' differing ignore lists, gateway routes and dangling servers. Scopes ou=siteminder and its source objects.
attributes.returns: {"type": "Projected", "description": "the neutral groups, the rewrite source objects' groups and containers, and notices"}

attributes.name: sections
attributes.purpose: Parse a server.conf-style file (section tags around name="value" lines, # comments) into a Section tree; an unclosed section is closed at the end

attributes.name: settings
attributes.purpose: The (name, value) settings of a name="value" agent file, in order (names may repeat)

attributes.name: named
attributes.purpose: The values of the settings called name, case aside, in order

attributes.name: first
attributes.purpose: The first value of the setting called name (case aside), or None

attributes.name: attr
attributes.purpose: A server.conf section tag's attribute value (case aside), or None

attributes.name: within
attributes.purpose: Every section called name inside a section, depth first

attributes.name: settings_outside
attributes.purpose: The settings of a section and the sections inside it, those inside sections called name left out (a gateway's server-wide settings)

attributes.name: parameters
attributes.purpose: (name, value) pairs of an ACO's "<name>=<value>" parameters as the export writes them

attributes.name: listed
attributes.purpose: The items of comma-separated values (IgnoreExt=".gif,.png"), each once, in order

attributes.name: agent_names
attributes.purpose: The agent identities settings name: each AgentName/AgentNameN mapping's name, then DefaultAgentName

attributes.name: allowed_local
attributes.purpose: Which LocalConfig.conf settings an ACO's parameters allow to override it (AllowLocalConfig): ALL, NONE or the listed names

attributes.name: is_allowed
attributes.purpose: Whether an ACO's allowance lets a local setting of this name override it

attributes.name: effective
attributes.purpose: An agent's effective settings: its ACO's, each name the ACO allows local configuration of replaced by LocalConfig.conf's values

attributes.name: matching
attributes.purpose: The folder file a path configured on the server names: the one sharing the longest tail of path components (file name at least), or None

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.purpose: A path's last component, lower-cased (either separator)

attributes.name: rules_document
attributes.purpose: Parse an Access Gateway proxyrules.xml: exactly one external DOCTYPE for the proxyrules root (SYSTEM/PUBLIC id, no internal subset) removed, then core xml_document (other declarations refused); root must be proxyrules

attributes.name: condition
attributes.purpose: A route condition string '<type>[:<header>] <criteria>[ <value>]'

attributes.name: parts
attributes.purpose: (type, header name or None, criteria, value) of a route condition string

attributes.name: routes
attributes.purpose: Flatten a proxy rules document into ordered leaf Routes (conditions on the way ANDed, document order = first-match order) and notices for elements not read

attributes.name: instances
attributes.purpose: Every SiteMinder Web Agent instance the record holds (smWebAgent under ou=web-agents,ou=siteminder), in DN order

attributes.name: server_of
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "e", "type": "Entry", "required": true, "description": "an smWebAgent or smRoute entry"}]
attributes.purpose: The server an instance runs on, or whose gateway a route is (its smServer); None when the record no longer holds it

attributes.name: carried_dn
attributes.purpose: The DN of the policy store export's source object of a kind named name (cn=<kind>-<name>)

attributes.name: agent_dn
attributes.purpose: The DN of the smAgent entry an agent name names

attributes.name: aco_parameters
attributes.purpose: The (name, value) parameters an ACO source object keeps in smConfig (none when no ACO)

attributes.name: local_settings
attributes.purpose: The (name, value) settings an instance's LocalConfig.conf sets, as its smConfig keeps them

attributes.name: instance_settings
attributes.purpose: An instance's effective agent settings: its ACO's overlaid by what its LocalConfig.conf may set

attributes.name: identities
attributes.purpose: The agent names an instance acts as, from its ACO's parameters and its LocalConfig.conf settings

attributes.name: acting_as
attributes.purpose: The enabled Web Agent instances acting as an agent identity

attributes.name: acos_naming
attributes.purpose: The ACO source objects whose parameters name an agent identity (DefaultAgentName, AgentName)

attributes.name: ignored_by
attributes.purpose: The extensions and URLs an agent passes through unprotected: what every enabled instance acting as it says (else the ACOs naming it), narrowed to what all say, with a notice naming those that differ

attributes.name: ignored_resources
attributes.purpose: The unprotected neutral path resources of an application an agent enforces: ignored extensions as wildcards below its base path, ignored URLs under it matched exactly; projected from the agent

attributes.name: file_concerns
attributes.purpose: The servers whose agent files name the source object at dn (an ACO, an HCO, a trusted host), in DN order

attributes.name: routes_of
attributes.purpose: A gateway server's routes (smRoute under ou=routes,ou=siteminder naming it by smServer), in the order it tries them (ciamOrder)

attributes.name: has_routes
attributes.purpose: Whether the record holds the routes of a server acting as a gateway agent

attributes.name: routing_objects
attributes.purpose: The DNs of the routing source objects the policy store export carried for a gateway agent (by its XID)

attributes.name: host_role
attributes.purpose: The role a host is in the record: the binding role published at it (core published_role), else a server's role at that hostname or address; None when unknown

attributes.name: coverage
attributes.purpose: 'all', 'some' or 'none': how many of an application's requests (its virtual host names, below its base path) a route's conditions take

attributes.name: backend
attributes.purpose: The Backend a forward target sends requests below base to ($0 the request URI, $1 what follows prefix), or None when it names other regex groups or no host

attributes.name: gateways
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "apps", "type": "tuple", "required": true, "description": "((realm application entry, agent DN), ...)"}]
attributes.purpose: What the record's gateway servers say of realm applications (backend, published roles) and of routes no realm covers (unprotected applications), with rewrites and notices

attributes.name: rewrite_entries
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true, "description": "the record as the import leaves it"}, {"name": "rewrites", "type": "tuple[Rewrite]", "required": true}, {"name": "at", "type": "datetime | None", "required": true, "description": "when the import read the files (ciamImportedAt), None for none"}]
attributes.purpose: The groups of the blocking rewrite source objects (rewrite-<application>), plus an empty group for each recorded one no route makes now; a recorded handling is kept

attributes.name: read_agent_files
attributes.purpose: Importer siteminder/agent-files: each server folder's Web Agent instances and an Access Gateway's routes below the server, source-object concerns, routing dropped, secrets withheld, then SiteMinder's projection

attributes.name: on_server
attributes.purpose: The SiteMinder instances or routes naming a server (smServer)

attributes.name: server_label
attributes.purpose: The name of the server an instance or route names (its DN when the record no longer holds it)

attributes.name: dangling
attributes.purpose: Notices for the Web Agent instances and gateway routes naming a server (smServer) the record no longer holds

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.purpose: What a route is called on its gateway: route-<its ciamOrder>

attributes.description: A server.conf section: its tag's name and attributes, its name=value settings in order, the sections inside it (an Access Gateway's server.conf; the whole file is Section '')
attributes.name: Section

attributes.description: One leaf of an Access Gateway's proxy rules: the conditions on its way (all must hold; '<type> <criteria> <value>'), forward or redirect, its target URL as written, a forward's filter class
attributes.name: Route

attributes.description: A gateway route sending an application's requests to another path than the request's: the application DN, the route DN, its conditions, its target as written, the base path and the backend path it becomes (a blocking rewrite source object)
attributes.name: Rewrite

attributes.description: What the record's Access Gateways say of the neutral layer: {application DN: attributes} for realm applications (backend, published roles), uncovered routes' applications with their resource, rewrites and notices
attributes.name: Gateways

attributes.description: Where a forward route sends an application's requests: the host's role in the record (or None), host, port, TLS (TRUE/FALSE) and the backend path for the application's base path
attributes.name: Backend

attributes.description: A Web Agent instance a server folder holds: its name (virtual host, ServerPath or webagent), its WebAgent.conf path, a gateway virtual host's names and settings, and server.conf's settings outside the virtual hosts (only their secrets recorded, withheld)
attributes.name: Plan

attributes.description: Milestone 115 items (a) and (b) (description there; decision/evolution 3111). (a) Access Gateway proxyrules.xml importer: each virtual host/path -> backend rule mapped onto the neutral protected-application layer (webaccess, milestone 110: applications' backend roles, published names, path resources), replacing today's blocking 'rebuild: its proxy rules aren't in the policy store' source object where the rules are read. (b) Web Agent files (WebAgent.conf, SmHost.conf, LocalConfig.conf per web server, Apache and IIS): agent name, host config, policy server list, trusted host name and local ACO overrides, sharpening the existing retire/rebuild source objects and linking agents to servers. (c) The admin policy REST collector stays later/optional (not this task). Vendor research first (Codex, read-only: file grammars per web server and Access Gateway release); design to the master before coding (it changes what the record holds: the user decides).
